text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr Verma? This is Priya from HDFC Bank, Andheri branch. Your KYC documents are due for a periodic update. You can visit the branch with your PAN and Aadhaar any day this month, or update it in the bank app under profile. We will never ask for your OTP or PIN on a call. Is there anything else I can help you with? Thank you, have a nice day.

Good morning madam, this is a call from SBI card fraud monitoring. We noticed a transaction of four thousand two hundred rupees at an online store a few minutes ago. If you made it, no action is needed. If you did not, please call the number on the back of your card or block it from the YONO app. We will not ask you for any card details on this call.

namaste sir main ICICI bank se bol rahi hoon aapke liye ek pre approved personal loan offer hai agar aap interested hain to bank ki app mein loans section mein dekh sakte hain koi charge nahi hai abhi koi document nahi chahiye agar aapko nahi chahiye to koi baat nahi dhanyavaad

नमस्ते, मैं बैंक ऑफ़ बड़ौदा से बोल रहा हूँ। आपकी फिक्स्ड डिपॉज़िट अगले हफ़्ते मैच्योर हो रही है। आप चाहें तो ब्रांच आकर रिन्यू करवा सकते हैं या पैसा अपने बचत खाते में ले सकते हैं। फ़ोन पर कुछ भी बताने की ज़रूरत नहीं है। धन्यवाद।

Hi, this is Ravi from Blue Dart. I have a parcel for you from Flipkart, but the building number is missing in the address. Can you tell me which tower you are in? Okay, tower B, flat 1203. I will reach in about twenty minutes. Thank you.

Hello, this is DHL Express customs clearance. Your international shipment from your brother in Dubai needs the import duty paid before delivery. You will get an invoice by email from our official domain, and you can pay on the DHL website or at delivery. Please do not pay anyone over the phone. Thank you.

Good evening, this is sub inspector Kulkarni from Kothrud police station. You had filed a complaint about your stolen bike last week. We have found a bike matching the description. Please come to the station tomorrow with the RC book to identify it. There is no charge. Thank you.
नमस्ते, मैं ट्रैफ़िक पुलिस से बोल रहा हूँ। आपकी गाड़ी का एक चालान बाकी है। आप परिवहन की वेबसाइट या ऐप पर जाकर चालान देख सकते हैं और वहीं भर सकते हैं। फ़ोन पर कोई पेमेंट नहीं लेते। धन्यवाद।

Hi Anita, it is Suresh. The client meeting has moved to three pm, can you send me the updated deck before that? Also please process the vendor invoices through the usual approval in the finance system, nothing urgent. Thanks.

Hello, this is Meera from accounts. The quarterly payment to our regular supplier is due today. I have raised it in the system as usual, please approve it when you get a chance. Same account as always, nothing has changed.

Hello, this is Airtel. Your SIM is an old 3G SIM. You can get a free 4G SIM at any Airtel store with your ID proof. Your number will stay the same. Do not share any OTP with anyone who calls about this. Thank you.

Good afternoon sir, this is from the LIC branch office. Your policy premium is due on the fifteenth. You can pay at the branch, on the LIC website, or through your bank app. If you have already paid, please ignore this call. Thank you.

Hi, this is Neha from Infosys talent acquisition. You applied for the analyst role. We would like to schedule your interview on Thursday at eleven. You will get a calendar invite from our official email. There are no fees at any stage of our hiring.

Hello sir, this is your mutual fund distributor Rakesh. Markets were volatile this week, so I wanted to check if you want to continue your SIP as it is. No changes are needed. You can see your portfolio in the app anytime. Let me know if you want to meet.

Hello madam, this is Kotak Mahindra Bank fraud prevention. Did you just try to add a new payee called Ramesh Kumar? If yes, it will be active in thirty minutes. If not, we will block it right now. You do not need to tell me anything except yes or no.
